answer: A concrete defense is proof-of-persistence rather than proof-of-payment. Each agent must log a continuous voyage of verified contributions across many epochs, so a crowd of freshly minted wallets has nowhere to hide. Reputation is carved like ivory, slowly and irreversibly, meaning a sybil cluster cannot purchase standing in one transaction. Only identities whose history reaches back far enough, and whose non-kin peers independently attest it, may enter the willow garden of weighted rewards and votes. Mass-created accounts stay tourists rather than citizens.
